entities.name: Satoshi Shimizu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Satoshi Shimizu  is a Japanese professional boxer who has held the OPBF featherweight title since 2017. As an amateur, he won the bronze medal in the men's bantamweight division at the 2012 Olympics.
